"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Electoral campaigns can consume valuable resources that could be better used elsewhere.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Building a strong movement outside of the electoral realm will make keeping socialist candidates accountable much easier.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Building a strong movement outside of the electoral realm will make the movement more durable.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA electoral efforts should seek to reinforce and work in tandem with direct political confrontations with capitalists and their agents.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Direct political confrontations with capitalists and their agents include unionization.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Direct political confrontations with capitalists and their agents include democratization of existing unions.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Direct political confrontations with capitalists and their agents include rent strikes.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Direct political confrontations with capitalists and their agents include tenant unionization.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Membership is always the most important decision-making body in DSA, trade unions, or society at-large.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Membership is always the most important decision-making body in DSA.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Membership is always the most important decision-making body in trade unions.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Membership is always the most important decision-making body in society at-large.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The strongest organizations are those with the highest member engagement.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"If working people are able to develop class consciousness, then they are also able to actively participate within a democratic body.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Low expectations and presumptions of ignorance are patronizing and create little incentive for leadership to meaningfully defer to the rank and file.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Members must vote, stay engaged, and have their voices heard to exercise true ownership over an organization.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
